title: dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ
titleEn: The Noble Truth of the Origin of dukkha
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.
groupSub: The Nearest Cause for the Origination of dukkha

paras.en:
“Now this, bhikkhus, is the noble truth of the origin of dukkha: it is this craving which leads to renewed existence, accompanied by delight and lust,
seeking delight here and there; that is,
craving for sensual pleasures, craving for becoming, craving for non-becoming.”
